name: Audit expedition model: dependsOn enforcement and keep/remove decision
goal: Determine whether the expedition model enforces the dependsOn property. Current evidence: checkUpstreamDependencies (lifecycle-completion based) is advisory-only (reported as a warning in expedition check/doctor), while isBlockedByUpstreamGate (review-gate based) blocks execution in domain/execution.ts and governance/intake.ts. Decide which dependency mechanisms to keep, harden (e.g., enforce lifecycle completion at start), or remove, and recommend the target model.
